SaveName: Roll for the Galaxy - NEW GAME (all fixes)
GameMode: Roll for the Galaxy - NEW GAME (all fixes)
Note:
To start, get every player in their seat and choose whether you want to add Ambition and Objectives.

-----------------------

Roll and arange your dice within your hidden zone and click ready when you are done. This will give your ready icon color.
Once everyone is ready the phase tiles will be flipped and everyone get's to do their turn (when abandoning tiles put them in the discard zone). After your turn is done press the Hide button and start rolling for your next turn.
Once everyone has hidden their area the turn ends. The discard zone is reshuffled into the bag and the phase tiles are flipped back.

    end
end

                v.destroy()
            end
            getObjectFromGUID(hiddenZone_GUID[player]).destroy()
            getObjectFromGUID(buttonZone_GUID[player]).destroy()
        end
    end
end

    seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()
    for i,players in pairs(seatedPlayers) do

            t.deal(2,players)
            params = {}

            params.rotation = homeworldRotation[players]
            h.takeObject(params).lock()

            params.rotation = factionRotation[players]
            f.takeObject(params).lock()

        end
    end

function readyClick(clicked_object, clicker)
    if clicker == nil then return end
    if endedTurn == nil then endedTurn = {} end
    if readiedPlayers == nil then readiedPlayers = {} end
    if hiddenZone_GUID[clicker] == nil then
        broadcastToColor('That seat has no player area in this mod.', clicker, {1,0.6,0.6})
        return
    end
    if endedTurn[clicker] == true then
        if readiedPlayers[clicker] ~= true then ready(clicker) else unready(clicker) end
    end
    seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()          -- refresh: seats change mid-game
    local allReady = true
    for i, pl in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
        if pl ~= 'Black' and pl ~= 'Grey' and pl ~= 'Pink' and hiddenZone_GUID[pl] ~= nil
           and readiedPlayers[pl] ~= true then
            allReady = false
        end
    end
    if allReady and phase == 'rolling' then startRound() end
end

function startRound()
    phase = "playing"
    for i,players in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
        if players != "Black" and players != "Grey" and players != "Pink" then
            getObjectFromGUID(hiddenZone_GUID[players]).translate({0,-10,0})
            endedTurn[players] = false
            unready(players)
        end
    end
    flipPhase()
end

function flipPhase()
    flipped = {
        Explore = false,
        Settle = false,
        Develop = false,
        Produce = false,
        Ship = false
    }
    for key,value in pairs(diceZones_GUID) do
        flip = false
        for key2,value2 in pairs(diceZones_GUID[key]) do
            inZone = getObjectFromGUID(value2).getObjects()
            for key3,value3 in pairs(inZone) do
                if hasValue(inDiceZone,value3.guid) == false then
                    flip = true
                end
            end
        end
        if flip then
            flipped[key] = true
            getObjectFromGUID(phasetile_GUID[key]).flip()
        end
    end
    -- 2-player rule (rulebook p.4): roll a spare white Home die. If it shows a
    -- phase neither player selected, that phase occurs this round as well.
    -- White Home die faces: Explore x2, Develop, Settle, Produce, Ship.
    local seatedNow = getSeatedPlayers()
    local nPlayers = 0
    for _, col in pairs(seatedNow) do
        if col ~= 'Black' and col ~= 'Grey' and col ~= 'Pink' then nPlayers = nPlayers + 1 end
    end
    if nPlayers == 2 then
        local faces = {'Explore', 'Explore', 'Develop', 'Settle', 'Produce', 'Ship'}
        local roll = faces[math.random(#faces)]
        if flipped[roll] ~= true then
            flipped[roll] = true
            local tile = getObjectFromGUID(phasetile_GUID[roll])
            if tile ~= nil then tile.flip() end
            broadcastToAll('2-player die rolled ' .. roll .. ' - that phase also occurs this round.', {0.6, 0.9, 1})
        else
            broadcastToAll('2-player die rolled ' .. roll .. ' - already selected, no extra phase.', {0.8, 0.8, 0.8})
        end
    end
end

function hasValue (tab, val)
    for index, value in ipairs(tab) do
        if value == val then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function ready(player)
    if player == nil then return end
    if readiedPlayers == nil then readiedPlayers = {} end
    readiedPlayers[player] = true
    local tok = getObjectFromGUID(readyTokens_GUID[player] or '')
    if tok ~= nil and colors[player] ~= nil then tok.setColorTint(colors[player]) end
end

function unready(player)
    if player == nil then return end
    if readiedPlayers == nil then readiedPlayers = {} end
    readiedPlayers[player] = false
    local tok = getObjectFromGUID(readyTokens_GUID[player] or '')
    if tok ~= nil and colors['Black'] ~= nil then tok.setColorTint(colors['Black']) end
end

function hideClick(clicked_object, clicker)
    if clicker == nil then return end
    if endedTurn == nil then endedTurn = {} end
    seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()          -- refresh before using it
    local zoneGuid = hiddenZone_GUID[clicker]
    if zoneGuid == nil then
        broadcastToColor('That seat has no player area in this mod.', clicker, {1,0.6,0.6})
        return
    end
    if clicker ~= 'Black' and clicker ~= 'Grey' and phase == 'playing' and endedTurn[clicker] == false then
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGuid)
        if zone ~= nil then
            zone.translate({0, 10, 0})
            endedTurn[clicker] = true
        end
    end
    local allDone = true
    for i, pl in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
        if pl ~= 'Black' and pl ~= 'Grey' and pl ~= 'Pink' and hiddenZone_GUID[pl] ~= nil
           and endedTurn[pl] ~= true then
            allDone = false
        end
    end
    if allDone and phase == 'playing' then endRound() end
end

function endRound()
    phase = "rolling"
    for key,value in pairs(flipped) do
        if value then
            getObjectFromGUID(phasetile_GUID[key]).flip()
        end
    end
    shuffleExplore()
end

function shuffleExplore()
    local bag = getObjectFromGUID(bags["Tiles"])
    if bag == nil then
        broadcastToAll("Game Tiles bag missing - explore shuffle skipped.", {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(discardZone_GUID)
    if zone ~= nil then
        for key,value in pairs(zone.getObjects()) do
            if value.guid != discardZone_GUID and value.guid != discard_GUID then
                bag.putObject(value)
            end
        end
    end
    bag.shuffle()
end

-- === Dice Cup: shake or tip it to pour rolled dice ===
-- TTS fires onObjectRandomize when it decides an object has been shaken - the same
-- moment it plays the rattle sound. Hooking that means our pour threshold IS the
-- game's own shake threshold, instead of a hand-tuned distance guess.
-- The cup mesh radius is ~2.37, so dice must spawn outside that or the bag re-eats them.
DICE_CUP_NAME = 'Dice Cup'
POUR_RADIUS   = 3.4   -- cup radius 2.37 + die half 0.31 + clearance
POUR_HEIGHT   = 1.2
DIE_SPACING   = 0.95   -- die is 0.62u wide; must exceed that
POUR_SIDE     = 1.0
FLIP_ANGLE    = 160.0
knownCups = {}
cupTipped = {}
cupShaken = {}
cupBusy   = {}

function isDiceCup(o)
    if o == nil then return false end
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return o.getName() end)
    return ok and n == DICE_CUP_NAME
end

function registerCup(cup)
    if cup == nil then return end
    local ok, guid = pcall(function() return cup.getGUID() end)
    if ok and guid ~= nil then knownCups[guid] = true end
end

function setupCup(cup)
    if cup == nil then return end
    registerCup(cup)
    pcall(function()
        cup.addContextMenuItem('Pour + Roll', function(pc) pourWithFlip(cup) end)
    end)
end

-- dir/rgt are captured before the flip animation starts, since tipping the cup
-- would otherwise swing its forward vector while we are placing dice.
function pourDice(cup, dir, rgt)
    if cup == nil then return end
    local items = cup.getObjects()
    local n = #items
    if n == 0 then return end
    local base = cup.getPosition()
    if rgt == nil then rgt = cup.getTransformRight() end
    -- pour out the cup's LEFT side
    local fx, fz = -rgt.x, -rgt.z
    local m = math.sqrt(fx*fx + fz*fz)
    if m < 0.15 then fx, fz, m = 0, 1, 1 end
    fx, fz = (fx/m) * POUR_SIDE, (fz/m) * POUR_SIDE
    local rx, rz = -fz, fx
    -- lay the dice out on a grid wider than a die (0.62u) so they cannot spawn
    -- overlapping - interpenetrating dice get flung apart by the physics solver
    local cols = math.ceil(math.sqrt(n))
    local rows = math.ceil(n / cols)
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        local idx = i - 1
        local c   = idx % cols
        local r   = math.floor(idx / cols)
        local ox  = (c - (cols - 1) / 2) * DIE_SPACING
        local oz  = r * DIE_SPACING          -- outward only; never back over the cup
        cup.takeObject({
            guid     = items[i].guid,
            position = {x = base.x + fx * (POUR_RADIUS + oz) + rx * ox,
                        y = base.y + POUR_HEIGHT + r * 0.15,
                        z = base.z + fz * (POUR_RADIUS + oz) + rz * ox},
            smooth   = false,
            callback_function = function(spawned)
                if spawned == nil then return end
                Wait.frames(function()
                    if spawned ~= nil then pcall(function() spawned.randomize() end) end
                end, 2)
            end
        })
    end
end

-- tips the cup over, pours, then rights it
function pourWithFlip(cup)
    if cup == nil then return end
    local guid = cup.getGUID()
    if cupBusy[guid] then return end
    if #cup.getObjects() == 0 then return end
    cupBusy[guid]   = true
    cupTipped[guid] = true          -- stop the tip detector double-firing
    local r   = cup.getRotation()
    local fwd = cup.getTransformForward()
    local rgt = cup.getTransformRight()
    pcall(function() cup.setRotationSmooth({0, r.y, FLIP_ANGLE}, false, true) end)
    Wait.time(function()
        pourDice(cup, fwd, rgt)
        Wait.time(function()
            pcall(function() cup.setRotationSmooth({0, r.y, 0}, false, true) end)
            Wait.time(function()
                cupBusy[guid]   = false
                cupTipped[guid] = false
            end, 0.5)
        end, 0.4)
    end, 0.4)
end

-- TTS decided the cup was shaken (this is what makes the rattle sound)
function onObjectRandomize(object, player_color)
    if isDiceCup(object) then cupShaken[object.getGUID()] = true end
end

function onObjectPickUp(playerColor, object)
    if not isDiceCup(object) then return end
    registerCup(object)
    cupShaken[object.getGUID()] = false   -- only a shake during this hold counts
end

function onObjectDrop(playerColor, object)
    if not isDiceCup(object) then return end
    local guid = object.getGUID()
    if cupShaken[guid] then
        cupShaken[guid] = false
        pourWithFlip(object)
        return
    end
    Wait.frames(function()                -- otherwise just stand it back up
        if object ~= nil and not cupBusy[guid] then
            local r = object.getRotation()
            object.setRotation({0, r.y, 0})
        end
    end, 3)
end

function onUpdate()
    for guid, _ in pairs(knownCups) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if o == nil then
            knownCups[guid] = nil; cupTipped[guid] = nil; cupBusy[guid] = nil
        elseif not cupBusy[guid] then
            local ok, up = pcall(function() return o.getTransformUp() end)
            if ok and up ~= nil then
                if up.y < -0.2 then
                    if not cupTipped[guid] then
                        cupTipped[guid] = true
                        pourDice(o)
                    end
                elseif up.y > 0.3 then
                    cupTipped[guid] = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function onObjectEnterContainer(container, object)
    if container == nil or object == nil then return end
    if container.getName() ~= DICE_CUP_NAME then return end
    pcall(function() object.randomize() end)
end

function onObjectLeaveContainer(container, object)
    if container == nil or object == nil then return end
    if container.getName() == DICE_CUP_NAME then
        Wait.frames(function()
            if object ~= nil then pcall(function() object.randomize() end) end
        end, 2)
        return
    end
    if isDiceCup(object) then
        Wait.frames(function() setupCup(object) end, 3)
    end
end

Wait.time(function()
    for _, o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if isDiceCup(o) then setupCup(o) end
    end
end, 2)

-- === resume support ===
-- The mod never defined onSave, so every load reset the script's state: phase,
-- who had readied, who had ended their turn. Object positions survive in the
-- save, the game logic did not - so a reloaded game came back showing the
-- setup buttons with the board mid-game. These handlers persist that state.
BTN_LAYOUT = {
    Red    = {hide = {-2, 0, 0}, ready = { 2, 0,  0}, rot = {0, 180, 0}},
    White  = {hide = {-2, 0, 0}, ready = { 2, 0,  0}, rot = {0, 180, 0}},
    Purple = {hide = { 0, 0, 2}, ready = { 0, 0, -2}, rot = {0,  90, 0}},
    Blue   = {hide = { 2, 0, 0}, ready = {-2, 0,  0}, rot = {0,   0, 0}},
    Green  = {hide = { 2, 0, 0}, ready = {-2, 0,  0}, rot = {0,   0, 0}},
}
bootDone = false

function makePlayerButtons()
    for colour, lay in pairs(BTN_LAYOUT) do
        local z = getObjectFromGUID(buttonZone_GUID[colour])
        if z ~= nil then
            z.clearButtons()
            z.createButton({click_function = 'hideClick',  label = 'Hide',
                function_owner = self, position = lay.hide,  rotation = lay.rot,
                width = 1300, height = 300, font_size = 200})
            z.createButton({click_function = 'readyClick', label = 'Ready',
                function_owner = self, position = lay.ready, rotation = lay.rot,
                width = 1300, height = 300, font_size = 200})
        end
    end
end

function boot(saved)
    if bootDone then return end
    bootDone = true
    seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()
    local st = nil
    if saved ~= nil and saved ~= '' then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved) end)
        if ok then st = decoded end
    end
    if st ~= nil and st.started then
        gameStarted    = true
        phase          = st.phase or 'rolling'
        if st.endedTurn      ~= nil then endedTurn      = st.endedTurn end
        if st.readiedPlayers ~= nil then readiedPlayers = st.readiedPlayers end
        makePlayerButtons()
        broadcastToAll('Game resumed - phase: ' .. tostring(phase), {0.6, 1, 0.6})
    else
        gameStarted = false
        setupButtonsInitial()
    end
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({
        started        = gameStarted == true,
        phase          = phase,
        endedTurn      = endedTurn,
        readiedPlayers = readiedPlayers,
    })
end

function onLoad(saved_state)
    boot(saved_state)
end

-- legacy callback name used by older TTS; deferred a frame so that if both
-- fire, the onLoad version (which carries the saved state) wins
function onload()
    -- Legacy callback. onLoad(state) is the one that carries the saved state,
    -- so wait long enough that it always wins if this TTS build fires both.
    Wait.time(function() boot(nil) end, 1.0)
end
